findings.message: The canonical detailed renders do not satisfy the required detailed floating civic-hub read. The runtime view remains a shallow, front-facing diorama with a dominant empty plaza; the top view is mostly an unarticulated slab; and the side view does not establish a credible floating island/underside or terraced civic depth. Added facade bays, rings, lamps, and planters are visible but do not correct the required spatial result.
